requirements.rule: Experimental descriptive, preliminary, replication, and reanalysis reports can fit the scope when reliable and methodologically sound. A Research article is the planned category. The 4600-word and four-figure limits apply specifically to Short Communications. The guide describes no general article-length restriction for regular open-access reports.
Single-anonymized review follows an initial editorial assessment; suitable manuscripts are normally sent to at least one independent expert reviewer. Acceptance remains an editorial decision.
Submit editable Word DOC/DOCX or LaTeX TEX source, rather than PDF as the manuscript. Word uses a single column. Include all artwork, captions, tables, and supplementary materials in the submission.

Provide title, full author names in the intended order, full institutional affiliations and postal addresses including country, and corresponding-author email. Link affiliations using lowercase superscript letters; numeric superscripts are reserved for present/permanent-address footnotes.

Designate one corresponding author to handle journal communications and serve as the primary contact; provide complete, current contact details. The guide does not expressly prohibit displaying an additional co-corresponding author in the manuscript. Retain established authorship and designate a single portal contact rather than silently deleting a co-corresponding designation.
Maximum 250 words; summarize purpose, procedures, principal findings with statistical significance when appropriate, and conclusions. Make it standalone and explain uncommon abbreviations.
Provide 1–7 English keywords. Prefer concise terms and avoid multiword constructions joined by and/of; abbreviations should be established.
Submit a separate editable file with Highlights in its filename, containing 3–5 bullets of at most 85 characters each, including spaces.

Encouraged rather than mandatory. If supplied, upload separately, at least 1328 pixels wide with the longest side horizontal, readable at 13 cm width; preferred formats include TIFF/EPS/PDF/MS Office.

Submit figures separately, number them in citation order, and provide captions explaining symbols and abbreviations. Vector EPS/PDF must embed fonts or convert text to graphics. Photographs need at least 300 dpi; bitmap line drawings need at least 1000 dpi.
Tables and equations must remain editable. Cite and number tables, add captions and notes, and avoid vertical rules and cell shading. Use SI units or provide equivalents when other units are used.
Cite all supplementary files in the article, submit them with the manuscript, provide concise descriptive captions, and ensure they are publication-ready because they are displayed as supplied.
Disclose all funding sources and identify the funder role in design, data collection, analysis/interpretation, writing, and submission decision. State explicitly when the funder had no such role.

Complete the publisher declaration tool even if there are no interests. Upload its declaration as DOC/DOCX; author signatures are not required. A locally prepared declaration is not evidence that the online tool has been completed.

Declare substantive generative-AI assistance in a separate section before the references, identifying the tool/service and purpose and confirming human review and author responsibility. AI cannot be an author.

Reproducible data visualizations derived from underlying data may be created with AI-assisted code. Disclose such use in the relevant caption and AI declaration. Do not use AI to fabricate or alter original experimental-image evidence; experimental-image processing must preserve scientific information.

Repository deposit and dataset citation/linking are encouraged under Option B. If sharing is not possible, explain why. A data-availability statement is encouraged and may independently be required by the funder or institution.
Place any actual acknowledgments in a separate section directly before the reference list. An empty Not applicable section can be omitted.
Identify each co-author contribution using applicable CRediT roles; authors may hold multiple roles.

Appendices within the article use letters A/B and corresponding equation/table/figure numbering. This does not mandate changing the names of external supplementary scripts; Supplementary Code is an optional clearer label.
Initial submissions can use any consistent reference style. Include complete applicable bibliographic metadata and available DOIs; ensure text citations and the reference list correspond.
Report the relevance of biological sex to design and interpretation, or acknowledge limits on generalizability; do not invent a retrospective justification for male-only sampling.
